text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I'm walking through the shopping
district
one evening...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Trainer! Your timing couldn't be
better!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Could you draw this for me? I've got to
get to
work soon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She forcefully jams a slip of paper into
the palm
of my hand. I take a closer look
and see...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I've got my sights set on the second
prize—a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The line is over there! I'm counting on
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look in the direction Ines Fujin is
pointing and
see a long line of families
who have just finished
shopping.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hand over the ticket I got from Ines
Fujin and
eagerly turn the handle on the
raffle device.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaat?! It's actually possible to win
the grand
prize?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Share some of that good luck with me,
will ya?!
Next time I get a chance, I'll win
myself a grand
prize, too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll let you keep it. You were the one
who won it,
after all.
choice_data_list: Wait, this hot springs trip ticket...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't feel right taking it after the
fact.
C'mon, hurry up and put it in your
pocket.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I said it's fine. Just accept it!
choice_data_list: Still, it belonged to you to begin...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Why not?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Just take it already, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Arrrgh! Wait, I've got an idea! How
about this?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep this coupon in reserve for
now! Once we find a time that fits both
our schedules, we'll
go. End of story.
Sound good?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... We've finally got that sorted,
then.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep it in this room for now. That
way you
can use it whenever you feel
like it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Geez...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You're such a handful.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! How many of you are dining
toda—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer?! Are you eating ramen
again?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: No, no, it's because I won first p...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's a carrot hamburger steak! Is it
really
okay for me to have this?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I'll eat it after I'm done with my
shift!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Say, Trainer. You didn't come all the way over here just to give me this, did you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You could've just given me it tomorrow.
You've
got a surprisingly cute side to
you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I hand over the deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak to Ines Fujin.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I receive a cardboard box packed full of
carrots,
which I decide to carry to the
student dorms. But
when I arrive...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I come across Oguri Cap, her stomach
loudly rumbling. With each rumble, she
visibly winces—it
seems her hunger has
reached its limit.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you hungry, Oguri?
choice_data_list: (At a time like this, Ines would...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'll share a few with you. I don't
have that
many, though, so keep this a
secret between us,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but they'd probably be tastier
cooked rather
than raw. How about I
whip you something up?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So that's why we're being treated to a
hot pot, huh? I was surprised when I
suddenly got a message saying to come
to your office after I
finish work.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ines! Your trainer's cooking is so
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My trainer is top-class,
after all! Right, I
think I'll
try a bit too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the giant box of carrots vanishes
in a single night, disappearing into an
abyss made up
of two Umamusume
stomachs...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
A single carrot, huh? Well, it is just a
raffle, after
all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for helping out on short notice,
anyhow! That raffle ticket was going to
expire after today,
so I'm glad it didn't
go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Let me know if you ever have a spare
ticket of
your own. I'll be there to help
you out, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It totally will!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hand over the carrot to Ines Fujin and
we head
home.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hello-lo, Trainer! About that raffle
ticket I gave
you yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You're looking a bit down in the
dumps first
thing in the morning...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What?! No way?!
choice_data_list: Actually, I drew a losing ticket i...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, no. I didn't mean it like that! I
just can't
believe you're feeling down
because of something
so silly!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, look, I'm sorry, okay? I never
expected you
to feel guilty over a
raffle...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I end up making Ines Fujin worry about
me
needlessly.
